title: Career Roadmap: IoT Agri Solutions Engineer
summary: Career Domain: Agriculture, Food & Life Sciences · Qualification Pathway: B.Tech / B.E. – Agricultural Engineering with Data Analytics · Target Career: IoT Agri Solutions Engineer

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: An IoT Agri Solutions Engineer designs and deploys sensor systems for farms: soil-moisture probes, weather stations, smart irrigation controllers and the dashboards farmers use to decide when to water, spray or harvest.
What a IoT Agri Solutions Engineer does

items.text: Choose sensors, controllers and networks (LoRa, GSM, Wi-Fi) for a farm's needs
Build and install devices, then keep them working in the field
Turn the readings into alerts and simple advice for farmers
Work with agronomists to check that the system really saves water or improves yield
Agri-tech start-ups and precision-farming companies
Irrigation and farm-equipment companies
Agricultural universities and KVK projects
Government digital agriculture and smart-village schemes
Learn agricultural engineering fundamentals: soil, water, crops
Start Python and basic electronics
Build a first Arduino soil-moisture sensor
Study irrigation engineering and drip/sprinkler design
Learn microcontrollers (ESP32), MQTT and cloud dashboards
Collect a season of real field data and analyse it
Build a full system: sensors + gateway + dashboard + alerts
Learn GIS (QGIS) and remote sensing basics
Intern with an agri-tech or irrigation company
Final project deployed on a real farm, with water or yield results
Learn device power, weatherproofing and maintenance
Build a portfolio and apply to agri-tech firms
